name: Palacio del Inka, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Cusco
positioning: Museum-like luxury hotel in a 500-year-old colonial mansion in the heart of Cusco, across from Qoricancha, the Temple of the Sun
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside Cusco's colonial and Inca history
Art lovers drawn to Cusco School paintings and pre-Inca to republican pieces
Guests who want a thermal spa circuit after a day of touring

facts.text: The hotel is housed within a 500-year-old mansion in the heart of Cusco.
The hotel is located across from Qoricancha, the Temple of the Sun.
On the main facade, Salas y Valdes carved four busts on the lintel of the portal.
The property is part of the central area of Cusco designated by UNESCO as Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
The lobby's sky-blue color is a tribute to the Andahuaylillas church, known as the Sistine Chapel of the Americas.
Bathrooms feature aged cream travertine marble and gilded light fixtures.
Guests can lounge on a private balcony with views of downtown Cusco or the distant Andes mountains.
Imperial suites offer street or Kusicancha courtyard views, with a private balcony in select suites.
Andes Spirit Spa treatments use Germaine de Capuccini products and combine ancient and modern techniques.
The Mantay Gallery shows contemporary work as part of the hotel's Route of Art.
Inti Raymi restaurant serves traditional Peruvian cuisine made with local Andean ingredients, in the lounge or on the Cuatro Bustos outdoor patio.
Rumi Bar is set beside original Inca walls from the ancient Qoricancha temple.

highlights.text: There are 195 pieces of art from the pre-Inca, Inca, colonial and republican periods on display, 60 of them original Cusco School paintings.
The 8-angled stone at the heart of the Incan-style wall is the only piece of the wall made of green diorite rather than granite.
Rooms have vaulted ceilings hand painted by local artists with colorful floral motifs.
The Andes Spirit Spa's thermal circuit offers a dry sauna, Turkish bath, Spanish showers with lighting effects and a Jacuzzi.
Guests can meet baby alpacas at the hotel as part of an experience.

considerations.text: The hotel does not offer on-site parking.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes the high-altitude location may take some adjustment.
